description:
Access German company intelligence built on official commercial-register records. handelsregister.ai brings company profiles, financial data, ownership structures, people and corporate relationships into ChatGPT.

Search for German companies using detailed criteria, then explore the information behind each result: registration history, financial statements, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, management and more. Retrieve official documents, examine corporate connections, and review register changes, insolvency publications and company news. Available website content and AI-enriched person profiles provide additional context.

Support company research, business partner checks, ownership analysis and targeted prospecting with connected company data in one conversation.

Connect your handelsregister.ai account to get started. Data lookups consume credits, and some features require a higher plan. Available information and ownership coverage vary by company, filing year and plan.

defaultPrompt: Analyze KONUX GmbH: summarize its business, management, latest available financial results, and recent register changes.
Find 20 active software companies in Bavaria with 50–250 employees and annual revenue above €10 million.
Who owns OroraTech GmbH? Show its shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and the companies it holds stakes in.
